description: Elections Commission - S. Arukgoda of the Kotapola Pradehsiya Sabha has vacated his memeber  of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna - G. H. reasoning: This gazette content contains multiple notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their offices as members of local government bodies (Pradeshiya Sabha and Urban Council) due to ceasing membership in a political party. This directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including declarations about candidate status and office vacancies.
